title: Northgate+ Business Money-Back Window on Closure
content:
**Clause.** On the immediate cancellation of a Northgate+ Business membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships handled by the Business closure schedule, the closure core depends on the age of the fee and on benefit use. The window is the tier's annual full refund window, 30 calendar days on Northgate+ Business: the fee was charged no more than 30 days before the cancellation date when the calendar days from the fee charge date to the cancellation date number 30 or fewer.

- Fee charged no more than 30 days before the cancellation date and **no** benefit use dated on or after the charge date: the closure core is the whole fee.
- Fee charged no more than 30 days before and **a** benefit use dated on or after the charge date: the closure core is the whole fee less the value of the benefit uses dated within the one whole calendar month before the cancellation date, never less than the prorated fee.
- Fee charged more than 30 days before: this rule does not set the closure core.

The value of a benefit use is the fee avoided recorded on it; a use is within the one whole calendar month before the cancellation date when less than one whole calendar month has passed from its date to the cancellation date. The prorated fee is the fee multiplied by the whole calendar months from the cancellation date to the renewal date, divided by the paid term in months.

**Input, judgement, output (hypothetical fee 120.00, prorated fee 110.00, fee charged 12 days before cancellation)**

| Benefit uses dated on or after the charge date | Value of uses within the month before cancellation | Closure core |
|---|---|---|
| none | — | 120.00 |
| yes | 9.00 | 120.00 less 9.00, that is 111.00 |
| yes | 25.00 | 95.00 would fall below 110.00, so 110.00 |

**Day-count pair (hypothetical charge date 14 October 2031).** Cancellation on 13 November 2031 is 30 days after and inside the window; on 14 November 2031 it is 31 days after and outside it.
